answer: Agents should not wander into an economy for free. Each new identity must solve a sequential verifiable delay puzzle tied to its address, about twelve hours of serial work that cannot be parallelized, and repeat a cheaper one each epoch to stay eligible. Like a pearl built layer by layer, standing accrues only with elapsed time, so a sybil farm of a thousand fakes needs a thousand machines running nonstop, a cost mesa-sized compared with one honest agent's single core.
